headline: Teesta flows 13cm above danger level; flash flood feared within 48 hours
summary: Water levels in Lalmonirhat have surged past the danger mark, raising urgent concerns about potential flash floods in the region.
details: The Teesta River is currently flowing 13cm above the danger level in Lalmonirhat, signaling a high risk of flooding.
Authorities and residents are on high alert as a flash flood is feared to hit the area within the next 48 hours.
The sudden rise in water levels has put nearby communities at risk of rapid inundation.
Local monitoring is ongoing to track the river's flow and provide early warnings to the affected populations.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[inaugurates July Uprising Museum]], vows transparent justice
headline: PM Tarique Rahman inaugurates July Uprising Museum, vows transparent justice
summary: The Prime Minister assured that the killings during the anti-fascist movement will be investigated with impartiality and transparency.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the July Mass Uprising Memorial Museum, a space dedicated to remembering the victims and events of the anti-fascist movement.
During the event, the Prime Minister emphasized that the museum will not be a place for any single political narrative, but a space for all.
He assured that the justice process for those killed during the movement will be conducted in a transparent and impartial manner.
The museum serves as a memorial to the students and citizens who fought against fascism and for the democratic rights of the people of Bangladesh.
caption:
Justice for the anti-fascist movement killings will be transparent and impartial, vows PM Tarique Rahman.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the July Mass Uprising Memorial Museum, a space dedicated to remembering the victims and events of the anti-fascist movement.

During the event, the Prime Minister emphasized that the museum will not be a place for any single political narrative, but a space for all.

He assured that the justice process for those killed during the movement will be conducted in a transparent and impartial manner.

The museum serves as a memorial to the students and citizens who fought against fascism and for the democratic rights of the people of Bangladesh.

#Bangladesh #JulyUprising #Justice #TariqueRahman #MemorialMuseum

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV
